series.name: United States harmonized policy rate
series.measurement: Central-bank policy rate (BIS harmonized series)
series.notes: BIS may splice policy instruments, and band midpoints can differ from stated edge rates.

series.name: Euro area harmonized policy rate
series.measurement: Central-bank policy rate (BIS harmonized series)
series.notes: BIS may splice policy instruments, and band midpoints can differ from stated edge rates.

series.notes: BIS may splice policy instruments, and band midpoints can differ from stated edge rates.

series.name: Federal funds target range upper limit
series.measurement: Upper bound of Federal funds target corridor
series.notes: Do not label as BIS harmonized policy rate.

series.name: ECB deposit facility rate
series.measurement: Deposit-facility policy rate
series.notes: Different concept from BIS harmonized euro-area policy series.

series.name: US 10-year inflation-indexed Treasury real yield
series.measurement: Ten-year constant maturity TIPS real yield
series.notes: Not the nominal 10Y yield; actual traded-market yield.

series.name: US real-time Sahm Rule recession indicator
series.measurement: Three-month unemployment mean versus prior 12-month minimum
series.notes: Primarily a recession onset indicator, not a leading crash predictor.

series.name: Real GDP growth (World)
series.measurement: Annual percent growth of GDP at constant local currency
series.notes: World Bank real GDP growth; annual observation, not a market-time-series proxy.

series.name: Real GDP growth (United States)

series.notes: World Bank real GDP growth; annual observation, not a market-time-series proxy.

series.notes: World Bank real GDP growth; annual observation, not a market-time-series proxy.

series.notes: World Bank real GDP growth; annual observation, not a market-time-series proxy.

series.name: Domestic listed equity market cap / GDP (US)
series.measurement: Listed domestic companies market capitalization divided by GDP
series.notes: Not equivalent to the full Buffett Indicator; listing domicile and gaps matter.

series.name: Domestic listed equity market cap / GDP (Japan)
series.measurement: Listed domestic companies market capitalization divided by GDP
series.notes: Not equivalent to the full Buffett Indicator; listing domicile and gaps matter.

series.name: US Shiller CAPE
series.measurement: Shiller U.S. cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio (CAPE) from monthly workbook
series.notes: Official Robert Shiller monthly ie_data.xls; source workbook format may change, and redistribution rights require review. Not a global valuation measure.

series.name: ACWI global equities CAPE (Siblis free snapshots)
series.measurement: Siblis global equity ACWI CAPE calculated from index company filings; available as sparse historical month-end snapshots
series.notes: Siblis proprietary free-tier API, non-commercial research only. Nine sampled month-ends, not a complete monthly historical record. No automatic redistribution to GitHub Pages: separate permission/licence required. See https://siblisresearch.com/data-licensing/.

series.name: US BEA Q1: equity market value / replacement-cost produced assets
series.measurement: Bureau of Economic Analysis Q1: market value of domestic nonfinancial corporate outstanding equities / net stock of produced assets valued at current (replacement) cost
series.notes: Official BEA Survey of Current Business 2026 Table E Q1, historical annual 1960-2024; updated annually. Q1 is equity-only numerator and differs from BEA Q2 (adds book bonds) and Q3 (market bonds plus net liquid assets). Current-cost produced assets denominator is capital stock plus inventories, not market net worth. Does not extrapolate 2025 or 2026.

series.name: Global labour share of GDP
series.measurement: SDG 10.4.1 global labour income share as a percentage of GDP (ILO-custodied, distributed by UNSD)
series.notes: Only worldwide UN SDG SL_EMP_GTOTL geography 1, Reporting Type G and Age ALLAGE. Annual estimates are revisions, not listed-company profit share.

series.name: Global productivity vs labour pay
series.measurement: Output per hour compared with compensation per hour
series.notes: World coverage and compensation comparability unresolved

series.name: Global listed-company profit share
series.measurement: Listed-company profits as share of economic output
series.notes: Global earnings dataset and multinational geographic allocation unresolved

series.name: Global equity index top-ten weight
series.measurement: Index share held by ten largest constituents
series.notes: Historical licensed constituent data unresolved

series.name: Cross-country credit-to-GDP gap
series.measurement: Credit-to-GDP gap using BIS methodology
series.notes: Exact per-country SDMX series key to be mapped

series.name: Live XAU/USD spot mid-price snapshot
series.measurement: Current indicative USD per troy ounce gold spot quote from Corgano (Swissquote bid/ask midpoint primary feed, fallback sources)
series.notes: Only the current live spot quote is available. Daily historical values advertised by this provider are COMEX front-month futures closes, NOT spot and must never be used for historical spot backfill. UTC as_of required; no public redistribution without upstream terms review.

series.name: 36-month gold / MSCI ACWI net-total-return correlation (USD)
series.measurement: Trailing 36 fully consecutive monthly Pearson correlation of USD monthly World Bank gold average returns and average daily MSCI ACWI USD net total-return index-level changes
series.notes: Genuine MSCI ACWI NETR index 892400; World Bank Pink Sheet nominal USD/troy ounce average. Both price and index measured as monthly mean levels before computing arithmetic monthly returns. Index levels include net dividend reinvestment under MSCI NETR; gold is monthly average commodity spot benchmark, not ETF or daily spot fixing. Only complete calendar months. Distinct from GLD/VT ETF proxy.

series.name: International government debt to GDP
series.measurement: IMF WEO DataMapper world general government gross debt, percent of GDP
series.notes: IMF DataMapper currently shows April 2026 WEO, not the later October 2026 WEO portal. Historical figures may be IMF estimates; current/future projection years excluded.

series.name: World Bank monthly gold price (USD per troy ounce)
series.measurement: Average monthly nominal gold price in USD per troy ounce
series.notes: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly average, not daily spot/total return. 1960 onward, workbook subject to monthly revisions, attribution required.

series.name: US credit-to-GDP gap
series.measurement: BIS credit-to-GDP gap, actual credit/GDP minus one-sided HP trend (CG_DTYPE=C); private non-financial sector, all lending sectors
series.notes: Country/area-specific BIS Basel III early-warning indicator. Cannot be summed into a legitimate worldwide gap; other CG_DTYPE codes are credit/GDP actual (A) or trend (B).

series.name: Euro-area credit-to-GDP gap
series.measurement: BIS credit-to-GDP gap, actual credit/GDP minus one-sided HP trend (CG_DTYPE=C); private non-financial sector, all lending sectors
series.notes: Country/area-specific BIS Basel III early-warning indicator. Cannot be summed into a legitimate worldwide gap; other CG_DTYPE codes are credit/GDP actual (A) or trend (B).

series.name: Japan credit-to-GDP gap
series.measurement: BIS credit-to-GDP gap, actual credit/GDP minus one-sided HP trend (CG_DTYPE=C); private non-financial sector, all lending sectors
series.notes: Country/area-specific BIS Basel III early-warning indicator. Cannot be summed into a legitimate worldwide gap; other CG_DTYPE codes are credit/GDP actual (A) or trend (B).

series.name: World real GDP per employed person growth
series.measurement: UN SDG 8.2.1 annual growth rate of real GDP per employed person, world aggregate, ages 15+
series.notes: ILO-custodied worldwide productivity growth. Does not represent wage growth or productivity-compensation divergence.

series.name: US nonfinancial corporate equities as % of net worth
series.measurement: Federal Reserve Z.1 nonfinancial corporate business, corporate equities as a percentage of net worth, level (NCBCEPNW)
series.notes: Useful US market-to-balance-sheet valuation proxy, NOT full Tobin's Q. Requires no replacement-cost assets assumptions. Source may make major quarterly structural revisions; public redistribution rights must be verified.

series.name: MSCI ACWI daily net total-return index level in USD
series.measurement: MSCI All Country World Index (large/mid cap developed and emerging markets), index code 892400, NETR USD official daily levels
series.notes: Genuine index net total-return levels. Not ACWI ETF price or vendor-adjusted close. MSCI public API history since 2000; prices may have holiday carry-forwards; no invented interpolation.
